unit.row: one point of the production Government Officer dataset (every production point is a row, as production counts them)
unit.count: แห่ง — points of the selection
unit.staff: คน — personnel production records at the office (types with a site count only)

staffRules.constant: ≥ 90% of the type's positive values are one value: a default, not a count
staffRules.scale: the type's 90th percentile is below 10: not a staff count for that kind of office
staffRules.agency: head offices of agencies: the agency's whole workforce, kept apart
staffRules.other: places that are not offices: production's value means students, 1 per point or 0

reconciliation.rule: rows and Σ officer per production district × category equal government-agency info lv0

adminMethods.overlay: the district of the point's production overlay subdistrict

repeats.rule: same type and same name (spaces and zero-width characters ignored), same province, chained within 100 m: points of one office — every point stays a row; the office's personnel is counted once, at the point with the smallest UUID that records it

staffOnce.rule: local government personnel is the organisation's (gov_name): counted once per organisation and province, at its office with the smallest key

rail.rule: operating = on the operator roster of CityMETER · Transit; construction = a project station, not a service; straight-line distance from the production point to the station reference point, up to 2000 m

events.rule: dated moves, new office buildings and service points 2024–2026 that production does not hold at their new place; linked to the production row the sheet names

ministry.rule: exact name of the row's agency (gov_name; for points without a category also the point's own name) = an agency of OPDC/DGA
